name: roadfm-lite
description: Command shortcuts for RoadFM-Lite (Python code; npm is only a task runner). Run from the repo root.
//: setup: setup, setup:cpu, setup:native, setup:venv, setup:venv:check, gpu:check, gpu:require
ec2: ec2:bootstrap, ec2:bootstrap:root, ec2:bootstrap:docker, ec2:check, ec2:dry-run, ec2:sim, ec2:sim:ubuntu
train (grid = default): train, train:check, train:smoke, train:one-batch, train:full, train:full:no-guard, train:recon-only, train:resume, train:runs, train:help
train grid: train:grid:check, train:grid:smoke, train:grid, train:grid:no-guard
train all: train:all:check, train:all:smoke, train:all, train:all:no-guard

hugging face: hf:whoami, data:upload, data:download, data:upload-input, data:download-input, data:upload-input:all, data:download-input:all, model:list, model:upload, model:download, model:upload:grid, model:download:grid, model:upload:all, model:download:all
simulator: sim, sim:data, sim:detect, sim:build, sim:test, sim:typecheck
docker: docker:build, docker:build:cpu, docker:shell, docker:shell:cpu, docker:check:cpu, docker:train

timesnet all/T32_benign (SEED=0|1|2, default 0): t32b:data:download, t32b:cache, t32b:cache:verify, t32b:check, t32b:smoke, t32b:train, t32b:train:no-guard, t32b:train:seeds, t32b:resume, t32b:eval, t32b:eval:random-init, t32b:eval:seeds, t32b:test, t32b:upload, t32b:download, t32b:ec2, t32b:short, t32b:eval:short, t32b:notebook

benign (TimesNet, all/T32_benign; SEED=0|1|2): benign:download (HF input + cache + verify), benign:train (full data, no memory cap, 72 h), benign:pause, benign:resume, benign:eval (eval + random-init + notebook), benign:upload (run + evaluations, every file, to HF)

contamination mix10 (ATTACK=gridsybil|datareplay|dosrandom|dosdisruptive): pipeline:encoder-input:all-t32-mix10 (build all/T32_mix10_<attack>, executed copy saved as build.executed.ipynb in it), mix10:cache (npy cache + verify), mix10:train / mix10:sync / mix10:eval / mix10:upload -- <attack> (src/model/all_t32_benign/experiments/README.md), mix10:notebooks, hf:download:mix10 (run + 2 evals), hf:download:mix10:all, hf:download:mix10:judges (judge reports of seed 0 -> src/runs/evaluation/all/T32_mix10_<attack>/judge-model-t32m10-<attack>-seed0)

small-T all-folder inputs (copies of the T32 builders, same vehicle split; executed copy saved as build.executed.ipynb in the output): pipeline:encoder-input:all-t20-benign, -t10-benign, -t5-benign, -t20-benign-grid, -t10-benign-grid, -t5-benign-grid
npm run <name> -- <args> passes <args> through; Python is ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python}

scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t20-benign: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T20_benign; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T20_benign.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T20_benign.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t10-benign: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T10_benign; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T10_benign.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T10_benign.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t5-benign: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T5_benign; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T5_benign.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T5_benign.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t20-benign-gr: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T20_benign_grid; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T20_benign_grid.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T20_benign_grid.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t10-benign-gr: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T10_benign_grid; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T10_benign_grid.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T10_benign_grid.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t5-benign-gri: O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T5_benign_grid; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T5_benign_grid.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T5_benign_grid.ipynb $T && nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.pipeline:encoder-input:all-t32-mix10: A=${ATTACK:?set ATTACK=gridsybil|datareplay|dosrandom|dosdisruptive}; O=src/data/encoder_input/all/T32_mix10_$A; T=src/data/encoder_input/all/.T32_mix10_$A.build.ipynb; cp src/pipeline/all/encoder_input_T32_mix10.ipynb $T && ATTACK=$A nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py $T; r=$?; mkdir -p $O && mv $T $O/build.executed.ipynb; exit $r
scripts.mix10:cache: A=${ATTACK:?set ATTACK=gridsybil|datareplay|dosrandom|dosdisruptive}; nice -n 15 ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m src.pipeline.all_t32_benign.cache --workers 3 --data-dir src/data/encoder_input/all/T32_mix10_$A --cache-dir src/data/cache/all/T32_mix10_$A && ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m src.pipeline.all_t32_benign.cache --verify --data-dir src/data/encoder_input/all/T32_mix10_$A --cache-dir src/data/cache/all/T32_mix10_$A
scripts.mix10:notebooks: for a in gridsybil datareplay dosrandom dosdisruptive; do NOTEBOOK_ONLY=1 bash src/model/all_t32_benign/experiments/mix10_eval.sh $a || exit 1; done && ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/run_notebook.py src/model/all_t32_benign/experiments/mix10_compare.ipynb --timeout 3600
scripts.hf:download:mix10: a=${ATTACK:?set ATTACK=gridsybil|datareplay|dosrandom|dosdisruptive}; s=${SEED:-0}; bash scripts/hf_fetch.sh runs/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s src/runs/pretraining/all/T32_mix10_$a/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s evaluations/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s src/runs/evaluation/all/T32_mix10_$a/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s evaluations/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s-random-init src/runs/evaluation/all/T32_mix10_$a/model-t32m10-$a-seed$s-random-init
scripts.hf:download:mix10:all: for a in gridsybil datareplay dosrandom dosdisruptive; do ATTACK=$a npm run hf:download:mix10 || true; done
scripts.hf:download:mix10:judges: for a in gridsybil datareplay dosrandom dosdisruptive; do bash scripts/hf_fetch.sh judges/model-t32m10-$a-seed0 src/runs/evaluation/all/T32_mix10_$a/judge-model-t32m10-$a-seed0 || true; done
scripts.hf:upload:grid: ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/hf_hub.py sums src/runs/pretraining/benign_gridsybil/T64/model-grid && ${HF:-hf} upload ${HF_MODEL_REPO:-bibekgupta3333/roadfm-lite-timesnet} src/runs/pretraining/benign_gridsybil/T64/model-grid runs/model-grid --repo-type model --private --include config.json --include env.json --include metrics.jsonl --include README.md --include best.pt --include last.pt --include '*.log' --include SHA256SUMS --delete '*' --commit-message 'Upload run model-grid (hf CLI)'
scripts.hf:upload:all: ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/hf_hub.py sums src/runs/pretraining/all/T24/model-all && ${HF:-hf} upload ${HF_MODEL_REPO:-bibekgupta3333/roadfm-lite-timesnet} src/runs/pretraining/all/T24/model-all runs/model-all --repo-type model --private --include config.json --include env.json --include metrics.jsonl --include README.md --include best.pt --include last.pt --include '*.log' --include SHA256SUMS --delete '*' --commit-message 'Upload run model-all (hf CLI)'
scripts.hf:download:grid: D=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT && ${HF:-hf} download ${HF_MODEL_REPO:-bibekgupta3333/roadfm-lite-timesnet} --repo-type model --include 'runs/model-grid/*' --local-dir "$D" && ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/hf_hub.py verify "$D/runs/model-grid" --install-to src/runs/pretraining/benign_gridsybil/T64/model-grid
scripts.hf:download:all: D=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT && ${HF:-hf} download ${HF_MODEL_REPO:-bibekgupta3333/roadfm-lite-timesnet} --repo-type model --include 'runs/model-all/*' --local-dir "$D" && ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} scripts/hf_hub.py verify "$D/runs/model-all" --install-to src/runs/pretraining/all/T24/model-all
scripts.hf:download:baselines: npm run hf:download:baselines:st && npm run hf:download:baselines:benign-t32 && npm run hf:download:baselines:benign-t48 && npm run hf:download:baselines:t64 && npm run hf:download:baselines:encoder && npm run hf:download:baselines:ae48 && npm run hf:download:baselines:ae32 && npm run hf:download:baselines:st-t32
scripts.hf:download:baselines:all-seeds: bash scripts/hf_fetch.sh baselines/autoencoder_st/seed1 task/autoencoder_st/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_st/seed2 task/autoencoder_st/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_st/seed3 task/autoencoder_st/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t32/seed1 task/autoencoder_benign_t32/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t32/seed2 task/autoencoder_benign_t32/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t32/seed3 task/autoencoder_benign_t32/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t48/seed1 task/autoencoder_benign_t48/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t48/seed2 task/autoencoder_benign_t48/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_benign_t48/seed3 task/autoencoder_benign_t48/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder_t64/seed1 task/autoencoder_t64/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_t64/seed2 task/autoencoder_t64/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_t64/seed3 task/autoencoder_t64/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder/seed1 task/autoencoder/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder/seed2 task/autoencoder/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder/seed3 task/autoencoder/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder_t32/seed1 task/autoencoder_t32/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_t32/seed2 task/autoencoder_t32/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_t32/seed3 task/autoencoder_t32/runs/seed3 baselines/autoencoder_st_t32/seed1 task/autoencoder_st_t32/runs/seed1 baselines/autoencoder_st_t32/seed2 task/autoencoder_st_t32/runs/seed2 baselines/autoencoder_st_t32/seed3 task/autoencoder_st_t32/runs/seed3 baselines/encoder/ae-seed0 task/encoder/runs/ae-seed0 baselines/encoder/ae-seed1 task/encoder/runs/ae-seed1 baselines/encoder/ae-seed2 task/encoder/runs/ae-seed2 baselines/encoder/ae-seed3 task/encoder/runs/ae-seed3 baselines/encoder/ae-seed4 task/encoder/runs/ae-seed4 baselines/encoder/evaluation_ec2_seeds0to4 task/encoder/runs/evaluation_ae_ec2_seeds0to4
scripts.hf:download:baselines:mae:all: npm run hf:download:baselines:mae && npm run hf:download:baselines:mae:resnet
scripts.hf:download:baselines:mae:small: bash scripts/hf_fetch.sh baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T20-seed0 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T20-seed0 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T20-seed1 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T20-seed1 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T20-seed2 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T20-seed2 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T20-seed3 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T20-seed3 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T10-seed0 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T10-seed0 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T10-seed1 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T10-seed1 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T10-seed2 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T10-seed2 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T10-seed3 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T10-seed3 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T5-seed0 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T5-seed0 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T5-seed1 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T5-seed1 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T5-seed2 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T5-seed2 baselines/masked_autoencoder/mlp/T5-seed3 task/masked_autoencoder/runs/mlp/T5-seed3

scripts.enc:ae: for s in 0 1 2; do ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m task.encoder.train --mode ae --seed $s || exit 1; done
scripts.enc:supervised: for s in 0 1 2; do ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m task.encoder.train --mode supervised --seed $s || exit 1; done
scripts.t32b:train:seeds: for s in 0 1 2; do ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m src.model.all_t32_benign.timesnet.train --seed $s || exit 1; done
scripts.t32b:eval:seeds: for s in 0 1 2; do ${PY:-.venv-train/bin/python} -m src.model.all_t32_benign.timesnet.evaluate --run src/runs/pretraining/all/T32_benign/model-t32b-seed$s || exit 1; done
scripts.t32b:ec2: npm run gpu:require && npm run t32b:data:download && npm run t32b:cache && npm run t32b:cache:verify && npm run t32b:check && npm run t32b:train && npm run t32b:eval && npm run t32b:eval:random-init
scripts.benign:pause: test -f src/runs/pretraining/all/T32_benign/model-t32b-seed${SEED:-0}/config.json && touch src/runs/pretraining/all/T32_benign/model-t32b-seed${SEED:-0}/PAUSE && echo 'pause requested: checkpoint after the current update (src/runs/pretraining/all/T32_benign/model-t32b-seed${SEED:-0})'
scripts.docker:check:cpu: docker compose run --rm cpu npm run train:check
scripts.docker:train: docker compose run --rm gpu npm run train:full
